sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 720. Deals physical damage 2 times that penetrates any nullifying or invulnerability effects with a success value of 100. (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies despair for 40 seconds with a success value of 140.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 100 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Fills Unison gauge by 20. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 120 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: all allies. Applies Serenity for 120 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Star Qualia (increases all stats by 100%, increases star elemental attack by 10, increases star elemental defense by 150, and nullifies Lethargy, Frail, and Abstraction) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 40.
Dark and Star Defense from Unison Damage +600
